terms.comment: Our description, with the lexicon’s autoraeda (car, Traupman 215) and ēlectricus, as in Traupman’s fūniculus ēlectricus, an electric cord (p. 309). Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for an electric car. It is charged like a phone: replēre.

sources: Lewis & Short: raeda
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 215, 309.
